audience: teams that send documents for e-signature and track them in Xodo Sign

useCases.title: Check which documents still wait for signers
useCases.text: List the documents of a business that are waiting for other people to sign. Open one to see each signer and whether that signer has signed.

useCases.title: Get the final signed PDF of a completed document
useCases.text: List the completed documents of a business. Get the download link of the final signed PDF. The tool returns the link, not the file.

useCases.title: Review the templates of a business
useCases.text: List the active, archived or draft templates of a business. Open one to read its fields and signer roles before you send a new document.

useCases.title: Send a signing reminder to a signer
useCases.text: Find a pending document and the signer who has not signed yet. Send that signer one reminder email. A reminder cannot be unsent.

useCases.title: Cancel a pending document
useCases.text: Cancel a pending document so that no signer can sign it. Cancelling does not delete the document.

useCases.title: Move a finished or draft document to the trash
useCases.text: Move a completed or draft document to the trash. A pending document must be cancelled first.
